title: FIPS mesh DNS projection (Phase B)
intended_behavior: When dns.projection.mesh_endpoints is enabled and dns.projection.mesh_zone is configured, online workers with FIPSOverlayAddr produce mesh DNS endpoints in the configured mesh zone.
Mesh endpoints use the worker DNS label and project to <worker-name>.<mesh-zone>.
Projected DNS records for mesh endpoints are AAAA records whose value is the worker FIPSOverlayAddr.
Workers without FIPSOverlayAddr, unhealthy/offline workers, or disabled mesh endpoint projection do not produce mesh records.
